propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider; clients must gateway through OpenAI-compatible proxy, losing caching and structured output
Prompt caching on Bedrock is model-dependent and fails silently (no error, full input billed) when unsupported, requiring a warning when cache counters are zero despite caching request

Bedrock rejects temperature parameter on some models (e.g. claude-opus-4-7) with 400 ValidationException, hard-failing rebar gates that use temperature=0 for deterministic re-verification, while the direct-Anthropic path degrades gracefully
The existing _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings in pydantic-ai applies only to Anthropic models, not Bedrock models, leaving Bedrock vulnerable to parameter-rejection 400s

Bedrock model caching capability must be tracked per exact model-id (not profile shape) because failure is silent and cost-bearing; us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 verified caching while us. and global. opus-4-5 silent-fail
The BedrockConverseModel builder must be in a separate leaf module (bedrock_model.py) not providers.py due to providers.py being at its 300-LOC attestation cap from closed story 7468
